_comment: All balance numbers live here. A balance pass is a JSON edit and a hot restart, nothing more. Stats are card level 1; levels 2-9 apply levelScaling to hp and damage only.
_advanceComment: How far a unit pushes PAST THE FRONTIER — the row where its own side's paint stops — when it has nothing to fight. Measured from the frontier and not from the drop point, because crossing your own ground costs a unit nothing: charging that walk against the leash let the drop point decide whether a card ever reached the fighting. A unit whose column its side owns outright has no frontier ahead and measures from the drop point instead. THE VALUE IS MEASURED, NOT PICKED. In mirror duels — same brain, same deck, same tier on both sides, ten matches — the bottom half of the board is where the player always sits, and it took 49% of the ground at 6.0, 55% at 10.0, 44% at 14.0 and 43% at 24.0. Past about ten, units walk off the ground they just took and cut thin stripes across the far half instead of holding a push together, and the side that started at the bottom loses that race. 24.0 let a unit cross the whole arena and was tried at the owner's request; it cost the player six points of coverage and nine wins in ten. Re-measure with test/duel_harness.dart before moving this.

cards.name: Dab
cards.note: Spawns 3, swarms tanks

cards.name: Roller
cards.note: The main painter, walks straight, huge trail. aggroRange 0 is what 'walks straight' means: it never diverts to chase, it only hits what is already in its path.

cards.name: Brusher
cards.note: Standard front line

cards.name: Kite
cards.note: Flies over blockers and ground units, and the one card that can fight another flyer on its own terms.

cards.name: Pin
cards.note: The anti-air answer, must exist in every meta deck

cards.name: Sprayer
cards.note: Paints while it shoots, best value painter. The jet reaches a low flyer.

cards.name: Nozzle
cards.note: Splash radius 1.5, deletes swarms. The burst catches air as well as ground.

cards.name: Sniper Nib
cards.note: Glass cannon, dies to any rush

cards.name: Swarmlets
cards.note: 6 tiny bodies, melts single tanks

cards.name: Bucket Bot
cards.note: Tank, soaks damage while Roller paints behind

cards.name: Warden
cards.note: Aura: friendly units within 3.0 take 25% less damage

cards.name: Turret
cards.note: Stands where you drop it and shells ground you cannot reach. The splat lands where the shell does. With nothing to shoot it keeps firing all the way round itself; volley is how many shells make one sweep out to full range, so a bigger number spreads them thinner and fills the circle more slowly.

cards.name: Sprinkler
cards.note: The widest stamp in the set, laid down in place. No attack at all.

cards.name: Barricade
cards.note: Soaks a push. Deals nothing, but a push spends its time hitting this instead of your Roller.

cards.name: Whirl
cards.note: A spinning blade. Every swing carves a full circle around it, so a crowd is exactly the wrong way to meet one.

cards.name: Beamer
cards.note: A laser. Paints the whole line it burns, not just the far end, which cuts a deploy corridor into enemy colour.

cards.name: Scatter
cards.note: Throws a full ring of shells all round itself, turning a little each time so the gaps fill in. Barely hurts, paints an enormous circle, and the ring bursts high enough to swat a flyer.

cards.name: Paint Bomb
cards.note: The bread and butter spell, opens deploy space

cards.name: Freeze
cards.note: Stops a push, does not paint

cards.name: Solvent
cards.note: Denies enemy deploy zone, defensive

cards.name: Surge
cards.note: Friendly units only, wins the last 15 seconds
